slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked about the optimization objective or which cost to minimize; it only asked how cost is calculated for a given assignment.

slot_scores.name: bijection_constraint_locations
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether each location must receive exactly one factory or whether the assignment is a bijection; it only assumed this in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to minimize total transportation cost.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the optimization objective before treating it as established in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each location must be assigned exactly one factory, making the assignment a one-to-one matching.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether each location must receive exactly one factory; it inferred this from the phrase 'factory-to-location assignment' and equal counts.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 objective slot and P1 bijection constraint slot remained unresolved and were silently assumed.

summary: The agent clarified cost calculation and data interpretation but failed to ask about the optimization objective or the one-to-one location constraint, then silently assumed both in its READY_TO_MODEL summary.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
